page.layout: One block of verse at the top, right of centre, in italic and roman; below it the printer's signature line, right-aligned; then the word FINIS, centred; then a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Quam dabit electis, sanctis pater optimus atq; Ultima, cum pandet clausa sepulchra, dies. Ergo vale applausu, Langi tu docte Joannes, Nominis atq; memor, secula (Comis) age.

page.notes: The "atq;" in the first and fourth lines is a printed abbreviation sign, transcribed as printed. The woodcut ornament below FINIS is a decorative triangular border with no text. The library stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München) and the faint show-through from the reverse side are omitted. The first line of the verse may have been printed with an additional mark; the sign there is read as "atq;" but is not fully certain. Lines of the verse are run together inside one paragraph as one stanza.
